chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah and Safwan from al-Ala' from Muhammad from one of the two Imams (peace be upon them)

Regarding a man who finishes his prayer having forgotten the Tashahhud until he has concluded (the prayer), he said: 'If it is near, he should return to his place and perform the Tashahhud; otherwise, he should seek a clean place and perform it there.' And he said: 'The Tashahhud is merely a Sunnah in the prayer.'
ai.seo_question: What should one do if they forget the Tashahhud until after finishing their prayer?
ai.summary: This narration from the *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* highlights the Shia juristic view that the Tashahhud is a Sunnah rather than a Fard (pillar), allowing for flexibility in its performance if forgotten. The instruction to find a 'clean place' (makhanan nazihan) for the delayed Tashahhud reflects the practical application of ritual purity (Taharah) in daily worship, emphasizing that the act retains its spiritual validity even when performed outside the formal prayer structure. This ruling underscores the balance between strict ritual adherence and ease (Yusr) in Shia fiqh.
